facts.statement: Fossil collectors found 35 right femurs but only one left femur of Sacisaurus.
facts.quote: among the dozens of fossil material unearthed, 35 right femora were collected whereas only 1 left femur was found

facts.statement: Scientists discovered Sacisaurus in 2001 in Agudo, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil.
facts.quote: Sacisaurus was discovered in 2001 in the small municipality of Agudo, in the countryside of Rio Grande do Sul state

facts.statement: The official announcement of Sacisaurus was made on November 1, 2006, at the University of São Paulo in Ribeirão Preto.
facts.quote: the announcement of the discovery of the new species was made on November 1, 2006 at the University of São Paulo, Ribeirão Preto

facts.statement: The scientific description of Sacisaurus was published in Historical Biology on October 30, 2006.
facts.quote: the paper was published in the British scientific journal Historical Biology: A Journal of Paleobiology on October 30, 2006

facts.statement: Sacisaurus is a silesaurid dinosauriform from the Late Triassic Caturrita Formation in southern Brazil.
facts.quote: Sacisaurus ("Saci lizard") is a silesaurid dinosauriform from the Late Triassic (Norian) Caturrita Formation of southern Brazil

facts.statement: Based on the largest femur, Sacisaurus was approximately 1.1 meters long and 35 centimeters high.
facts.quote: Sacisaurus was approximately 1.1 m long and 35 cm high, based on the largest femoral specimen

facts.statement: Sacisaurus had long, strong legs that suggest it was a fast animal.
facts.quote: Its long and strong legs indicate that it was a fast animal

facts.statement: The largest teeth of Sacisaurus were only 3 millimeters long.
facts.quote: The biggest teeth of the genus were just 3 mm long

facts.statement: Sacisaurus possessed a bone at the tip of its jaw that resembles the ornithischian predentary bone.
facts.quote: there is a process at the tip that resembles the ornithischian predentary bone

facts.statement: A 2011 cladistic analysis identified the silesaurid Diodorus from Morocco as the closest relative of Sacisaurus.
facts.quote: In 2011, a cladistic analysis of some of its morphological particularities found that its closest relative was the silesaurid Diodorus, from Morocco

facts.statement: Sacisaurus lived in southern Brazil approximately 220 million years ago during the Triassic period.
facts.quote: Sacisaurus agudoensis es un género extinto de dinosauromorfo perteneciente a la familia de los silesáuridos que vivió en el sur de Brasil hace 220 millones de años, en el período Triásico

facts.statement: Research at the University of São Paulo revealed that Sacisaurus was not a dinosaur but a reptile from a different lineage still linked to dinosaur ancestors.
facts.quote: Un estudio realizado en la Universidad de São Paulo por Ribeirão Preto reveló que el animal no era un dinosaurio, sino un reptil de un linaje diferente linajes, aunque aún vinculado a los antepasados de los dinosaurios

facts.statement: PhD student Jonathan Bittencourt presented conclusions leading to the reclassification of Sacisaurus at the 7th Brazilian Symposium of Vertebrate Paleontology.
facts.quote: Jonathan Bittencourt, estudiante de doctorado, presentó las conclusiones que condujeron a la reclasificación de la criatura durante el 7º Simposio Brasileño de Paleontología de Vertebrados, en Río

facts.statement: Bittencourt's thesis found that the jaw and teeth of Sacisaurus evolved independently of ornithischians.
facts.quote: En su tesis analizó la genealogía de los dinosaurios más antiguos que vivieron cerca de 220 millones de años. Encontró que la mandíbula y los dientes de Sacisaurus evolucionó de forma independiente de los ornitisquios

facts.statement: The parent group of Sacisaurus is Sulcimentisauria.
Sacisaurus belongs to the family Silesauridae.
The Paleobi Database classifies Sacisaurus under the class Ornithischia.
Sacisaurus lived during the Norian stage, from 227.3 to 205.7 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Norian to Norian (227.3 to 205.7 million years ago)

rejected.statement: The genus name Sacisaurus honors Saci, a famous one-legged creature from Brazilian mythology.
rejected.quote: Sacisaurus refers to Saci, a famous one-legged creature from Brazilian mythology
